prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cropped shot of a shirtless young man standing in front of a corrugated metal wall. The composition focuses on the right side of his torso and arm, with his skin catching natural daylight, creating subtle highlights and shadows that emphasize his musculature. He wears black pants with the waistband of his underwear visible, featuring the word "UOMO" in bold white letters. The background consists of weathered, silver-gray corrugated metal, with dents and small bolts visible, adding a gritty, urban texture. The color palette is dominated by muted metallic tones and warm brown skin, with high contrast and sharp detail. The overall style is documentary-like and raw, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the subject in crisp focus while the background remains slightly blurred. The camera angle is straight-on at torso level, evoking a sense of immediacy and realism.
